questions.q_en: A solid toy is in the form of a hemisphere surmounted by a right circular cone. Height of the cone is 2cm and the diameter of the base is 4cm. If a right circular cylinder circumscribes the solid, find how much more space it will cover.
questions.solution_en:
Let BPC be the hemisphere and ABC be the cone standing on the base of the hemisphere.

Radius BO of the hemisphere (as well as of the cone) = ½ * 4 = 2 cm

Now, let right circular cylinder EFGH circumscribe the given solid, radius of the base of the right circular cylinder = HP = BO = 2 cm

Height of the cylinder = AP = AO + OP

= 2cm + 2cm = 4 cm

Now, Volume of the right circular cylinder - Volume of the solid

= (π * 22 * 4 - (2/3 * π * 23 + 1/3* π * 22 * 2)) cm3

= (16π - 8π) cm3

= 8π cm3

questions.q_en: The radius of a sphere is √5 times the radius of another sphere. What is the ratio of surface area of bigger sphere to that of smaller sphere?
questions.solution_en:
Radius of smaller sphere * √5 = Radius of bigger sphere

Required ratio = 4π * (radius of bigger sphere)2/ 4π * (radius of smaller sphere)2

= (√5/1)2 = 5: 1

questions.q_en: The thickness of a spherical metallic shell is 3 cm and external radius of the shell is 9 cm. The density of the shell is 14/11 mg/cubic cm. Find the mass of the shell.
questions.solution_en:
External radius of shell= 9 cm

Thickness of shell = 3 cm

Internal radius of shell = 9 - 3 = 6 cm

Volume of shell = 4/3* π* (93 - 63) =4/3* π* 513 = 684π cubic cm

Density of the shell = 14/11 mg/cm3

Mass of the shell = volume * density

= 684* 22/7* 14/11 = 684* 4 = 2736 mg.

questions.q_en: Find the surface area (in sq. cm) of a sphere whose volume is 310464 cubic cm. Use π = 22/7
questions.solution_en:
Vol of sphere = 4/3 πr3

=> 4*22*r3 / (3*7) = 310464

=> r = 42

Surface area = 4πr2

= 4*22*42*42 / 7

= 22176 sq. cm

Express method

As all the options are given as whole numbers. We can use the divisibility rule of 11 to find the answer.

questions.q_en: How many balls of radius 6 cm after melting can form a hemispherical bowl of 12 cm?
questions.solution_en:
Total number of balls = n

Volume of hemispherical bowl = (2/3) x (22/7) x 12 x 12 x 12

Volume of each ball = (4/3) x (22/7) x 6 x 6 x 6

Then, (2/3) x (22/7) x 12 x 12 x 12 = n x (4/3) x (22/7) x 6 x 6 x 6

n = 4

questions.q_en: A spherical iron ball with 4 m external radius has mass of 3564 kg. What is the thickness of the shell if the density of iron ball is 13.5 kg/m3?
questions.solution_en:
External radius r2 = 4 m

Mass = 3564 kg

Density = 13.5 kg/m3

Internal radius = r1

Volume = 4/3 π (r23 - r13)

= 4/3 X 22/7 (43 - r13)

Density = mass/volume

13.5 = 3564 X 21 / {88 X (43 - r13)}

(43 - r13) = 3564 X 21 / (88 X 13.5) = 63

r13 = 64 - 63 = 1

r1 = 1 m

Thickness of iron ball = 4 - 1 = 3 m

questions.q_en: The volumes of a sphere and a right circular cylinder having the same radius are equal. The ratio of the diameter of the sphere to that of the height of the cylinder is:
questions.solution_en:
Volume of sphere = 4/3 πr3

Volume of cylinder = πr2 h

As given, πr2 h= 4/3 πr3

=> h = 4/3 r

=> h/r = 4/3

=> h/2r = 4/(3 X 2) = 2/3

=> d/h = 3/2 [where d = 2r]

questions.q_en: Find the total surface area of a hemisphere if the lateral surface area of the hemisphere is 196 sq. cm.
questions.solution_en:
We know that the ratio of the total surface area to the lateral surface area of a hemisphere is 3: 2.

Given,

2 units = 196 sq. cm

3 units = 196 * 3/2 = 294 sq. cm

Hence, total surface area of a hemisphere = 294 sq. cm
